formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signature to permit() on the AAVE token proxy, the spender's AAVE allowance from the owner (the signer) is set to exactly `value`. Any earlier allowance for that spender is replaced.
The signer's permit nonce goes up by one, so any other permit signed with the same nonce stops working.
The signature is valid until `deadline`. type(uint256).max means it never expires.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens", with the spender address, the maximum AAVE amount ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or above), the expiry date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit deadline: type(uint256).max means no expiry, but the date field shows a far-future date
findings.evidence: BaseAaveTokenV2.sol permit natspec: '@param deadline the deadline timestamp, type(uint256).max for no deadline'; the descriptor field 'deadline' has format 'date', encoding 'timestamp', and no way to say 'no expiry'.
findings.fix: No date-format parameter can say 'no expiry' today. Wallets should show a sentinel date for the maximum value as 'No expiry'.

findings.title: Permit has no test case, so the Unlimited threshold and max-deadline renderings are unexercised
findings.evidence: FORMATS.md: 'cases: 0 (no tx)' for the Permit format.
findings.fix: Add EIP-712 test messages for a finite value, a value of 2^256-1 (should show 'Unlimited') and a deadline of type(uint256).max.
